result.summary: Adds snake_case aliases for option arguments in the listunspent RPC method. It also refactors wallet RPC option lookup to share a single GetOptionWithAlias helper.
result.problem: Wallet RPC options historically mixed naming conventions. In listunspent, options still lacked snake_case variants, preventing consistent argument naming across wallet RPC interfaces.
evidence: PR description: 'This concludes the snake_case aliases for all wallet option objects or named args.'
Commit facf53acf4: 'This does not change any behavior, but makes possible future deprecation easier.'
result.card: Adds snake_case aliases for listunspent RPC options and shares a common GetOptionWithAlias helper across wallet RPCs. This completes snake_case aliasing for wallet option arguments across the wallet interface to prepare for potential future deprecation of legacy names. It is an internally-motivated interface consistency cleanup with no external dependencies.

risk.why: Mistakes in option parsing could cause listunspent to ignore filter parameters or reject valid user inputs.
